name: Armament Haki
description: Busoshoku: invisible armour of will, for striking, guarding and, at its height, breaking from within.

stages.name: Coat the body
stages.description: Wrap a limb in an invisible armour of will.
stages.text: Your fist struck as if wrapped in iron, though nothing was there.

stages.name: Harden
stages.description: The coating turns black and hard.
stages.text: Your arm went black as lacquer and the blade bounced off it.

stages.name: Coat a weapon
stages.description: Extend the armour into a blade, a bullet, a staff.
stages.text: Your weapon went black in your hands, and cut what it should not have.

stages.name: Full-body coating
stages.description: Coat the whole body, and hold it.
stages.text: You held the black over your whole body for an hour.

stages.name: Emission
stages.description: Strike from within, without touching: the Wano tradition calls it Ryuo.
stages.text: Your strike landed before your fist did: the air between went black.

stages.name: Internal destruction
stages.description: Send the will inside the target and break it from within.
stages.text: You laid a hand on the wall and it burst from the inside.

stages.name: Imbue a blade until it turns black
stages.description: Years of coating one blade until it stays black for good.
stages.text: After years of coating it, your blade stayed black when you let go.

teachers.name: Silvers Rayleigh, if he is willing
